summaries.genai-developer-aosmith: Accomplished GenAI Developer with 6.5+ years of software engineering experience and expertise in Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent orchestration, and Python/Go backend engineering. Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating refactoring, testing, and deployment to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven architecture, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% for Turbot HQ, Inc.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and Terraform-driven integration testing; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to a push-based, event-driven model via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent to resolve cross-team queries by ingesting documentation and code graphs for all internal repos into AWS S3 vector storage (embeddings-based retrieval); deployed to AWS Lambda and integrated with the Slack Bot API, resolving onboarding and cross-team queries instantly.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent (Model Context Protocol)
projects.description: Agentic chatbot/agent framework built with Pydantic AI, producing structured outputs, featuring configurable external MCP servers via a persistent MongoDB-backed registry that routes tool calls per server with per-server failure isolation, native tool/function calling, mid-conversation multi-model switching (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral), conversation-history persistence for multi-turn context management, sync + streaming output, prompt-injection safeguards, and Logfire observability/tracing.
